note: Raccords (hubs) appelés par la V8 mais absents, et variantes pour les arbres profonds V1. Les raccords existants gagnent aussi quelques variantes d'ouverture.

npc_variantes: Anyway, I won’t keep you.
Well, I should let you get on with your day.
Alright. Good talking to you.

choices.npc: Same. Don’t be a stranger.
If I survive the week, sure.
Go on, quickly.
You too.

npc_variantes: New around town? Let me think.
Oh, you haven’t heard?
Depends. Do you want gossip or facts?

choices.npc: The big flea market on Saturday. Debbie already printed the rules. Twice.
Nothing I’d repeat. Okay, maybe one thing, but not here.

choices.player: Is the café busy these days?
choices.npc: Always. Marcus is testing a new sauce and everyone has opinions.
Sure. If anything happens, you’ll hear it by lunch.

npc_variantes: Honestly? It’s been a week.
My week? Let me count the days. All of them were long.
Not bad. Could be quieter.

choices.npc: A quiet evening. They’re rare, so I’m counting it.
Thanks for noticing. I think.
That’s kind. I’ll let you know.
Trying. Thanks.

npc_variantes: Okay, this conversation took a turn.
I like where your head’s at. I don’t understand it, but I like it.
We are not normal people, are we?
I feel like we just invented a new holiday.
This is the kind of talk that ends up on the town noticeboard.

choices.npc: Is there a receipt?
No. One of us has to stay sane.
Reality, right. Overrated, but fine.

choices.player: I should go before it gets weirder.
choices.npc: Wise. Very wise.

npc_variantes: Anyway, work doesn’t do itself.
Back to the real stuff, then.
You know, about my job…

choices.npc: Busy. Good busy, mostly.
People. The work is easy, people are the hard part.
Most days. The other days, I like lunch.
Appreciated.

npc_variantes: Need anything else?
Anything I can actually help with?
Is that all for today?

choices.player: Where’s the best place to sit around here?
choices.npc: The benches by the fountain. Bring a snack, the pigeons are organized.
Wednesday around the fountain, Saturday on the big square. Early is better.
Well, hi. That was nice.
Anytime.

neighborhood_smalltalk: Anyway, how has your week been treating you?
So, how’s life on your side of the street?
Enough about that. How are you holding up?
local_work_or_smalltalk: Well, the day is not going to run itself.
light_banter: That might be the strangest thing I have heard today.
You’re a strange one. I mean that kindly.
I’m going to remember that, unfortunately.
You have a very specific sense of humor.
family_chat: So, what is happening with you lately?
How’s the family? Still busy with the cards?
You look like someone with news.

refus_par_interlocuteur.note: Remplace « Understood. Thanks for being decent about it. » (800 occurrences) selon qui parle.
Neighbor: No problem. The box isn’t going anywhere.
Sure. Knock if you change your mind.
Fair enough. I’ll keep the garage door open.
Parent vendor: Okay. My kid will be relieved, honestly.
No worries. We’re here until three.
Got it. I’ll ask the parents’ group instead.
Collector: Understood. I respect a buyer who walks away.
Fine. Patience is part of collecting.
Noted. Come back when you’re sure.
Card shop owner: Of course. Better no deal than a bad one.
That’s fine. The counter will still be here.
Okay. Smart buyers sleep on it.
Parking seller: Fine, fine. I’m parked here till noon.
Alright. I’ll find someone in a hurry.
Online buyer: No problem. I’ll keep the listing open.
Okay. Message me if you change your mind.
Understood. Thanks for answering quickly, at least.
Parent at home: Alright. Just don’t sell the house.
Fair. Sleep on it, that’s what I’d do.
Flea vendor: Sure, dear. Maybe something else will catch your eye.
Okay. Everything must go, but not today apparently.
Regular customer: Sure. I’ll be around Saturday anyway.

reformulations_honnetes.note: Remplace la réponse terminale qui répétait mot pour mot « All right. Here is the honest part: X. Anything beyond that needs checking. » ; {fait} = X.
modeles: So, to be precise: {fait}. The rest is guesswork until we look.
Facts first: {fait}. Anything more and I’d be making it up.
That’s the solid part: {fait}. We check the rest together.
No surprises from me: {fait}. Beyond that, your guess is as good as mine.

reformulations_conditions.note: Remplace la redite de « Potentially. {condition}. We can talk after the facts are clear. »
modeles: Like I said: {condition}. Once the facts are clear, we talk.
Same answer, different words: {condition}. Facts first.
I haven’t changed my mind: {condition}. Then we’ll see.

reformulations_motifs.note: Remplace la redite de « {motif}. That is why I care about this. »
modeles: Like I said, {motif_min}. It matters to me.
It all comes back to that: {motif_min}.
You already know: {motif_min}. So yes, I care.

variantes_reponses_raccords.note: Réponses alternatives aux choix des raccords les plus fréquents (clé = réplique du joueur).
Please do not take that as a challenge.
I believe you. That’s the scary part.
Save it for the talent show.
It had potential. It didn’t use it.
Smart. Leave on a high note. Or a medium one.
Can I return it for store credit?
No. One of us has to stay sane.
Absolutely not. Okay, maybe one more.
I’m out. This is your show now.
Reality called. It wants its normal conversation back.
Good call. It was heading somewhere strange.
Go, before I start agreeing with you.
